# Command reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m sample_shepherd.cli_reference > docs/cli/reference.md`.
     Don't edit by hand: tests/test_cli_reference.py fails when this is out of date. -->

Every command and flag, generated from the code. For what each command is for and how it
keeps you safe, see [commands.md](commands.md). `sample-shepherd <command> --help` prints
the same information.

## Global options

These go before the command: `sample-shepherd --device 2 device info`.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--config CONFIG` | config file (default: see `sample-shepherd config show`) |
| `--work-dir WORK_DIR` | where backups and logs go by default |
| `--device DEVICE` | device number (from `sample-shepherd device ls`) |
| `--elektroid-cli ELEKTROID_CLI` | path to elektroid-cli |

## `config`

Show the settings in effect.

### `config show`

Print the settings in effect.

No options.

### `config init`

Write a starter config file to edit.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--path PATH` | where to write it (default: ~/.config/sample-shepherd/config.toml) |

## `organize`

Curate a library with Fourier Samples.

### `organize doctor`

Check that Fourier is installed and configured.

No options.

### `organize build`

Run `fourier build` (with --dry-run: Fourier's own dry run).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `args ...` | more arguments for fourier build, after -- |

### `organize patches`

List our patches to Fourier.

No options.

### `organize install-fourier`

Build the patched Fourier our profiles need.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--dir DIR` | where to clone and build it (required) |
| `--python PYTHON` | Python for its venv (uv's --python) |

## `export`

Render to targets by device profile.

### `export profiles`

List device profiles.

No options.

### `export render`

Render a master for a profile (runs `fourier render`).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `profile` | profile name (see `export profiles`) |
| `--from MASTER` | the master to render (default: Fourier's config) |
| `--out OUT` | output folder (default: Fourier's config) |
| `args ...` | more arguments for fourier render, after -- |

### `export check`

Check a render against its profile's limits (reads only).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `render` | the rendered folder to check |
| `--profile PROFILE` | the profile it was rendered with (required) |
| `--show SHOW` | issues to print (default `30`) |
| `--max-name-length MAX_NAME_LENGTH` | flag longer sample names (default: 32 for Elektron profiles; 0 turns it off) |

## `device`

Connected devices and their sample storage.

### `device ls`

List connected devices.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |

### `device info`

Show the device's filesystems (what it supports).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |

### `device listing`

List the sample storage to CSV (read-only).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--out OUT` | CSV to write: path,size,hash (required) |
| `--root ROOT` | device folder to list (default /) |

## `projects`

Project backups and the samples they use.

### `projects ls`

List projects on the device.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |

### `projects backup`

Download every project, one folder per slot.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--out OUT` | backup folder (default: &lt;work_dir&gt;/backups/&lt;today&gt;) |
| `--slots SLOTS ...` | only these slots |

### `projects used`

List the samples the backed-up projects use.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--backups BACKUPS` | folder of project backups (required) |
| `--out OUT` | CSV to write: path,size,hash,projects (required) |
| `--allow-partial` | go ahead even if the backup can't be shown to hold every project |

## `plan`

Compare listing, project usage and an export; write upload/delete plan.

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--listing LISTING` | CSV from `device listing` (required) |
| `--used USED` | CSV from `projects used` (required for any delete) |
| `--export EXPORT` | rendered folder to sync |
| `--folders FOLDERS ...` | only these top-level folders of the export |
| `--dest DEST` | device folder to sync into (default /) |
| `--prune` | delete device files in the synced folders that the export doesn't have |
| `--replace REPLACE` | CSV of device paths to delete once replaced (path or '+Drive path' column) |
| `--out OUT` | plan CSV to write (required) |

## `sync`

Carry out a plan on the device (resumable).

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would happen; change nothing |
| `--plan PLAN` | plan CSV from `plan` (required) |
| `--used USED` | CSV from `projects used`; every delete is checked against it again |
| `--log LOG` | log CSV (default: &lt;plan&gt;-log.csv); a rerun skips what it lists as done |
| `--yes` | go ahead with the plan's deletes |
| `--no-delete` | only upload |
